{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify premises
loyal_count = df['customer_segment'].value_counts().get('loyal', 0)
assert loyal_count > 0, "No loyal customers found. Premise failed."

converted_unique = df['converted'].unique()
assert set(converted_unique) == {0, 1}, "'converted' has unexpected values. Premise failed."

segment_unique = df['customer_segment'].unique()
assert 'loyal' in segment_unique, "'loyal' segment not found. Premise failed."

# Extract loyal customers
df_loyal = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute number of loyal customers
n_loyal = len(df_loyal)

# Compute number who converted
n_converted = df_loyal['converted'].sum()

# Compute fraction converted
fraction_converted = n_converted / n_loyal

# Print all required numbers
print(f'n_loyal = {n_loyal}')
print(f'n_converted = {n_converted}')
print(f'fraction_converted = {fraction_converted}')"}
